top_signals.title: Cantor Co‑CEO: AI Capex Will Drive Trillions in New Debt
top_signals.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald Co-CEO Christian Wall joins Bloomberg Open Interest from the firm's New York headquarters to break down a record 2025, a more complicated 2026 and why he thinks AI infrastructure will drive trillions of dollars in new debt issuance. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cantor’s 9/11 Charity Day
top_signals.summary: On September 11th, 2001, Cantor Fitzgerald lost 658 employees in the World Trade Center attacks. Twenty-five years later, the firm has turned its worst day into one of Wall Street’s biggest days of giving. In this exclusive look inside Cantor’s New York trading floor, Chairman Brandon Lutnick and Executive Vice Chairman Kyle Lutnick explain how employees now waive a day’s pay for Charity Day, raising a record $15 million last year through the Cantor Fitzgerald Relief Fund and why they’re determined to top it on the 25th anniversary. (Source: Bloomberg)
